name: forgerail-cross-workspace-orchestration
description: Govern safe parallel work across independent owner workspaces with single-writer and receipt-review boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Govern parallel work across independent owners.
interface.longDescription: An optional ForgeRail capability pack for master-task coordination across genuine owner, repository, or release boundaries. It governs dependency waves, single-writer identities, independent approvals, stable handoff review, host fallback, and recovery without becoming an execution runtime.
defaultPrompt: Plan safe parallel work across independent owner workspaces.
